cues.txt: I've spent the last 20 years of my life
trying to be successful. I've been
climbing up in my career. I've been
pleasing others. I've been working hard
and I've been doing all the things that
I thought the world would call me
successful for. It worked. To many
people, I'm considered successful. But
as someone who has struggled with
self-doubt, low confidence, and
insecurities for pretty much all of my
life, for a very long time, I have not
felt successful on the inside, no matter
how successful I was on the outside. Why
am I telling you this? Because I think
this is relevant for you if you're
someone who's similar to me. If you are
also a quiet, introverted individual,
you've hit a certain level of success in
your career, but you're now at a point
in your life where you're feeling a
little stuck, you're feeling insecure
about where you're at, you're feeling

today's video that you pre-order this
